title: zetta.SolutionCatalog
description: The AI Solution Library: a catalog of ready-to-deploy ExecutionGraph blueprints. Mirrored by the embedded schema in src/core/solution_catalog.cpp and enforced by zetta::parse_solution_catalog() (include/zetta/solution_catalog.hpp) — keep the three in sync. The per-blueprint `graph` is the IR's canonical JSON form (see docs/execution-graph.md); its structural rules (unique node ids, no dangling/duplicate edges) are enforced by zetta::ir::from_json after this shape check.

solutions.description: The blueprints in the library. Ids must be unique within a catalog.

id.description: Stable slug, unique in the catalog (e.g. "churn-prediction").

name.description: Human name shown in the Deploy panel.

summary.description: One-line description of the outcome the solution delivers.

graph.description: The deployable blueprint in the ExecutionGraph IR's canonical JSON form.

attributes.description: Free-form configuration bag for the step.

kind.description: Edge type; defaults to data_flow when omitted.
